interactions.check: 320px focused home search expands to 150px with query and clear control
Recommended empty query shows one empty state; reset clears region and query
Travel tab retains My trips, create trip and journals
Find filters preserve Busan + cafe + 7-day scope while switching to meetups
Saved folder + region + stay + text query intersect to exact hotel
Food and hotel detail images load with address and description
Saved removal restores focus to next surviving row
Manual DAY1 add then DAY2 move updates visible Move/Undo labels and exact counts
Creation next step keeps question below sticky header with inputs at 16px
Chat notice and newly created poll accessible in one fixed context row after latest scroll
Chat search empty state, successful original jump and same activity preparation navigation

exception: Existing compact photo attribution control retains 28px height; primary actions checked at 44px minimum.
limitations: Viewport and software keyboard space simulated in browser; physical Android/iOS keyboard not exercised.
Actual backend, OAuth, realtime and LLM remain separate from this UI change.
